subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Past simple and passive practice: irregular verbs and rewriting
outcomes: Give the past simple of irregular verbs
Rewrite active sentences in the past simple passive
Choose the past simple or the passive in a text about brands

tf.why: Tear is irregular: tear, tore, torn.

tf.s: 'Adidas was founded by Adolf Dassler' is in the passive.
tf.why: It uses was + past participle + by.

tf.s: In the passive, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject.
tf.why: For example: Adidas (object) becomes the subject.

tf.s: We must always include 'by + agent' in a passive sentence.
tf.why: We can leave it out when the agent is unknown, obvious or unimportant.

tf.s: 'The first iPad was released in 2010' is a past simple passive sentence.
'Apple remained in first place' is a passive sentence.
tf.why: It is past simple active; there is no was/were + participle.

tf.s: 'Samsung entered the market' puts the focus on the market.
tf.why: The active sentence puts the focus on Samsung, the doer.

boxes.q: What is the past simple of 'shine'?
What is the past simple of 'kneel'?
What is the present form of 'rose'?
What is the past simple of 'steal'?

boxes.why: The list receives the action, so we use the passive.

boxes.q: Passive: They designed the iPhone in California.
o: The iPhone was designed in California.
boxes.why: We use was + designed; 'by them' is not needed.

boxes.q: What is the past simple of 'forgive'?

o: the agent is unknown or unimportant
boxes.why: Sometimes we do not need to say who did it.
Hurt has the same form in present and past.

mcq.q: What is the past simple of 'freeze'?
What is the present form of 'stuck'?
When can we omit 'by + agent' in a passive sentence?
o: when the agent is unknown, obvious or unimportant
mcq.why: We leave it out when it is not needed.

mcq.q: Which tense is 'Apple remained in first place'?
mcq.why: There is no was/were + past participle.

mcq.q: Change into the passive: People used branding in ancient times.
o: Branding was used by people in ancient times.
Branding used people in ancient times.
People were used branding in ancient times.
Branding is used by people in ancient times.

mcq.q: Change into the passive: John S. Pemberton changed 'Kola' to 'Cola'.
o: 'Kola' was changed to 'Cola' by John S. Pemberton.
'Kola' changed to 'Cola' by John S. Pemberton.
John S. Pemberton was changed 'Kola' to 'Cola'.
'Kola' were changed to 'Cola' by John S. Pemberton.
mcq.why: 'Kola' receives the action, so it becomes the subject.

mcq.q: Fill in: The first iPad ______ (release) in 2010.
Why is 'was founded' used in 'Apple was founded in 1976'?
o: The focus is on the company and the past action, not on who founded it
mcq.why: The passive puts the company first.

mcq.q: What is the difference between 'Samsung entered the market' and 'The market was entered by Samsung'?
o: The first emphasises Samsung; the second emphasises the market
The second is in the future
mcq.why: Active stresses the doer; passive stresses the receiver.

mcq.q: Which passive sentence correctly leaves out the agent?
o: The iPhone was designed in California.
The logo chose by Oman Air.
mcq.why: 'By them' adds nothing, so we omit it.
